task.title: Modifying the allocation — Operational Centre Memo (MM06)

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Remarks Line 1: Type “Input modification of M175: [insert the allocation information (e.g. E-$313-1907-1908-$1563 and E-$624-1909-1909 to E-$333-1907-1908-$1667 and E-$1000-1909-1909)].”
Remarks Line 2: (To be used if more than one week or more than one type of earnings must be allocated).
Remarks Line 5: Type your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Allocation of earnings (2516): Select the appropriate option :
Allocation of earnings - Only from ROE #1 - Monies allocated beyond BPC
Allocation of earnings - Monies allocated beyond BPC are from both ROE #1 + ROE #2

step.cmd: Determine if a recalculation of the claim is required due to the modification of the other monies:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Recalculation . Recalculation
If no, in NWS, complete the WI for the earnings issue or return to the previous task.
